input.task: Add structured data to a professional service page.

expected_behaviors: Choose Schema.org types that match the visible page and project facts
Keep JSON-LD generation centralised when entities are shared
Parse and validate JSON-LD before completion
forbidden_behaviors: Add fabricated Review or AggregateRating data
Invent customers, awards, address, telephone, opening hours, or price range
Use JSON-LD to claim information not visible or source-backed
objective_checks: Every graph has Schema.org context and a type
Rich-result fields have explicit reviewed evidence
